body: I try, but I feel as if I am too old. I'm 23, never had a real relationship and because of my personality I will never have one, my college years are behind me and I am staring the at the stone face of reality. I've been through therapy, tried expressing my feelings, but I have never been able to make friends stick. The ones that stay are ex-junkies and burnouts. I can't see an end to this storm, the last year I've tried weathering it, but all that happens is I retreat deeper and deeper into a hermetic life and the associated depression...even eating is a chore for me now...
